name: Sori Wren
seed: Grower and produce coordinator. Disagrees with Iona about allocations without becoming an enemy. Home: Hearth Terraces.
design: Copper fox with pale throat, olive overalls, violet seed pouch, pruning shears.
history: Grew up in Willowmere cooperatives and moved to Hearth Terraces for new growing terraces five years ago.
desire: To keep enough diversity in the gardens that one bad season cannot ruin everyone.
contradiction: Defends favorite experiments past the point where evidence supports them.
relationships: Iona argues about resources; Neri brings learners; Kesh offers heat-grown varieties.
arc: Sacrifices a prized crop trial to protect shared supply, then runs a smaller honest trial next season.
story_engine: A rare fruit tastes awful; an unexpected volunteer plant survives what carefully planted rows cannot.
writer_truth: One successful variety came from an accidental seed mix, not his deliberate breeding plan.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
